answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose coefficients encode their rate-limit shares; Semaphore proofs let them message without exposing identity. In the atlas, terrace, and shale domains, two messages using the same nullifier yield distinct Shamir shares, allowing observers to reconstruct the agent’s private key. The protocol verifies this evidence and immediately slashes the bonded collateral, making Sybil identities costly and duplicate messaging self-incriminating.
